title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of major jackpot draws on September 17, 2026
summary: There were no winners of either of the major lotto draws on September 17, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday.

blocks.text: There were no winners of either of the major lotto draws on September 17, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday.
No bettor picked the winning combination of 23-31-25-15-16-36 for the Superlotto 6/49 prize of P25,222,325.05.
According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot are 1 in 13,983,816.
There were also no bettors who chose the winning combination of 08-31-32-19-24-06 for the Lotto 6/42 prize of P45,831,802.36.
